row: As an experienced, mobile Sports Massage Therapist, I visit your home, workplace or sports venue. I treat people of all ages and backgrounds (not just sports people!), whose conditions or symptoms may arise from over use, injury, surgery, degenerative conditions and neurological disorders, to name just a few. If you are experiencing pain, discomfort, reduced mobility, have an injury or want to improve personal performance, contact me to discuss your condition and see how I can help. I am  based in Rugby, Warwickshire. I use manual therapy, soft tissue techniques and movement education to aid your recovery and my goal is to empower you to control/eradicate your condition by identifying and treating the cause, not just the symptom. Self-care has never been more important.  Learn to stretch, strengthen, relax and use self massage techniques, as you begin to understand what is happening to your body.
